# TMG Plumbing & Heating Services

> Specialist heating and plumbing company based in Waterford, serving
> residential and commercial clients across South East Ireland since 2006.
> Domestic coverage: Waterford, Wexford, Kilkenny, Tipperary, Kildare.
> Commercial coverage: nationwide.

Email: info@tmgplumbing.ie
